nodes.label: wWinMain / main()
nodes.desc: Cross-platform entry point: loads config and resources, generates tokens, starts the local server, then switches on the app mode (window, chrome, browser, cloud).

nodes.label: settings::init()
nodes.desc: Parses neutralino.config.json and exposes per-mode options such as port, documentRoot, tokenSecurity and nativeAllowList.

nodes.label: resources::init()
nodes.desc: Picks a resource mode at boot: embedded via postject, resources.neu bundle, or plain directory fallback.

nodes.label: authbasic
nodes.desc: Generates a 96-character access token at startup and verifies one-time tokens and WebSocket connect tokens.

nodes.label: permission
nodes.desc: Enforces nativeAllowList / nativeBlockList method gating and filesystemScopes read-write path checks.

nodes.label: neuserver::init()
nodes.desc: Creates the websocketpp asio server, binds 127.0.0.1 by default (0.0.0.0 in cloud mode), reads back the real port and builds the navigation URL.

nodes.label: handleValidate()
nodes.desc: Rejects WebSocket upgrades unless the host is localhost and the URL carries a valid connectToken (and a loaded extensionId for extensions).

nodes.label: handleMessage()
nodes.desc: Parses each WebSocket frame as JSON {id, method, accessToken, data} and hands it to the native method router.

nodes.label: handleHTTP()
nodes.desc: Serves the static frontend over plain HTTP on the same port, forwarding Range headers for partial content.

nodes.label: router::executeNativeMethod()
nodes.desc: Auth and permission gates, then dispatches through a 127-entry methodMap of C++ controllers.

nodes.label: 14 native API modules
nodes.desc: app, window, os, filesystem, computer, storage, events, extensions, clipboard, debug, net, custom, server and res controllers.

nodes.label: router::serve()/getAsset()
nodes.desc: Serves files from the resource tree with a built-in MIME table, SPA fallback and mounted virtual paths.
